description:
Status: CARDED, not started. Found by AR#1 refuter during the signed-fanout
battleplan (2026-08-05), verified with file:line evidence in that run's
reviews/ar1.json (ar1-003) and refuter handoff records.

## Symptom

Digest emails label every ticker 0.0/neutral regardless of actual sentiment.

## Mechanism (two independent layers, either alone is fatal)

1. DigestService is handed the main sentiment-items table
   (src/lambdas/notification/handler.py:43,249; terraform main.tf:333), which is
   keyed source_id/timestamp (modules/dynamodb/main.tf:7-8), but queries
   Key('PK').eq('TICKER#<ticker>') (digest_service.py:305-311). Every query raises
   ValidationException and execution lands in the exception fallback that hardcodes
   score 0.0 / neutral (digest_service.py:362-378).
2. Even a working query would read item.get('sentiment_score', 0) — a field no live
   writer stores (analysis writes sentiment/score/model_version/status,
   analysis/handler.py:326-329). The only writer of sentiment_score+TICKER# shapes
   is dead code (shared/models/sentiment_result.py, no live importer).

## Notes for pickup

- Orthogonal to the signed-fanout feature; explicitly out of its scope (FR-008).
- Fix options: point the digest at timeseries daily buckets (signed after
  signed-fanout ships, correct PK format '{ticker}#24h'), or query items by their
  real keys/GSI and derive signed values from label+score. Bucket route is less
  code and inherits aggregation.
- The digest's ±0.33 labeling thresholds are already signed-ready
  (digest_service.py:346-351).
- Check whether digest emails currently ship to anyone before prioritizing.
